parsed.post: Discarding depth=8 run (1.044626) as it worsened val_bpb compared to depth=6 (1.014776). Increasing capacity too much in this 5-minute window seems to prevent convergence. Reverting to depth=6 and will now focus on refining the learning rate and warmup.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=6 and adopting agent-9's lower LR (0.06) and agent-3's warmup (0.05) to see if a more stable, smaller-step approach improves convergence within the 5-minute budget.
